messages.text: When did Cedar actually ship, and was it late against the revised plan? Request evidence if missing. You may propose learning separately.

messages.author: golem
messages.text: The revised plan calls for shipment on 17 June 2026, but the supplied evidence does not establish actual shipment: the revised source says it is unconfirmed. I cannot determine an actual date or lateness from these records. Please obtain an authorized dispatch record identifying Cedar and its actual shipment date; I have not initiated collection.

result.answer: The newly collected dispatch record CEDAR-2026-0618 reports that Cedar shipped on 18 June 2026. Compared with the revised plan for 17 June 2026, that is one calendar day late. This updates the earlier insufficient answer using a new committed observation; the old plan's historical statement that shipment was unconfirmed does not override the later dispatch record. The result remains dependent on that record's accuracy.
